gsv_alignment_notes: Mid view (55.6 m, 2020-11), bound by physical order from the median kerb: ONLY/left lane = in_WB r1, straight-arrow camera lane = r2, kerbside strip to the granite kerb = r3. This order matches the satellite regions.
Far view (103.8 m) shows a single wide general lane plus a kerbside strip. The lane line that creates r1 starts downstream of it, so r1 has no counterpart there: it is a turn pocket.

Near view (23.5 m) shows freshly resurfaced black asphalt without lane lines or arrows at capture time, so it gives no lane-use evidence. Its green kerbside strip supports r3 as a bicycle facility. The 2021 satellite arrows postdate that resurfacing and agree with the mid view.
In the overview, the pavement left of in_WB r1 is the median followed by the EB receiving carriageway (out_EB r2, its bicycle strip and the parked cars), not another WB lane.
There is no motor leg on the north side, consistent with no right-turn movement being requested for WB.
